crypto.driver_write_mapping: 0x1214d..0x12163 computes physical ByteOffset; 0x122aa..0x122c9 passes that value in RCX to sub_13450; 0x1232e ZwWriteFile persists transformed bytes

facts: When the preferred new-label read fails, the historical controller reads LBA7, converts the 0x40 legacy type4 entry into a runtime entry, and passes StartSector/PartitionSize/NeedEncrypt to EdpMountFile.
The driver bounds all virtual I/O to PartitionSize and maps virtual offsets to backing_offset + virtual_offset, so a 0xC00 Region A mount covers exactly all six sectors.
The zero 8-byte key plus mapped physical-byte tweak regenerates both captured physical Region A ciphertexts bit-for-bit from the independent vrvaud_c plaintext template.
